query: A finite sum of nonnegative real numbers vanishes if and only if every summand vanishes

items.name: Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {s : Finset ι} [AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} [Subsingleton (AddUnits M)] : ∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0

items.name: Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
items.type: {ι : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [Fintype ι] [AddCommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : ι → M} (hf : 0 ≤ f) : ∑ i, f i = 0 ↔ f = 0

items.name: Fintype.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos
items.type: {ι : Type u_8} {M : Type u_9} [Fintype ι] [AddCommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : ι → M} (hf : f ≤ 0) : ∑ i, f i = 0 ↔ f = 0

items.name: Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [AddCommMonoid N] [PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι} [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] : (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) → (∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0)

items.name: Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonpos
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [AddCommMonoid N] [PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι} [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] : (∀ i ∈ s, f i ≤ 0) → (∑ i ∈ s, f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0)

items.name: Finset.sum_mul_self_eq_zero_iff
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i * f i = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0

items.name: Finset.sum_sq_eq_zero_iff
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2 = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0

items.name: Finset.sum_pow_eq_zero_iff_of_even
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (heven : Even n) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ n = 0 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 0
